Paper Structure

Section 2

Abstract

LLM-driven Madhyamaka-GPT + ATOM 3D framework for teaching MMK to digital natives.

Section 3

Introduction

Challenges of teaching emptiness; role of AI and 3D pedagogy; research questions.

System Architecture

Next.js 15, ThreePanelVerseViewer, React Three Fiber, Gemini AI, Whop SDK.

Section 5

Madhyamaka-GPT Design

10-phase instruction framework; source hierarchy; Gate 2 scientific guardrails; RESONANCE algorithm.

Showcase Verse Analysis

Verses 1.1, 1.10, 1.13, and 24.18 as illustrative case studies.

Alignment with Conference Sub-Themes

🇮🇳

1. Role of AI in Reviving IKS

Primary

27 chapters of MMK are presented with AI-scaffolded explanations, interactive 3D, gamification, and printable completion certificates. The project aims to preserve philosophical depth while increasing accessibility.

⚖️

2. Ethical AI from Wisdom

Primary

Madhyamaka-GPT operates under strict epistemological constraints: canonical source hierarchy, Gate 2 scientific integrity checks, explicit analogy labeling, and Research Mode transparency.

📜

3. Rescuing Ancient Texts with AI

Primary

Devanagari Sanskrit where available, IAST transliteration, Garfield & Siderits translations, and Candrakīrti-grounded commentary are being organized into an interactive learning environment for digital learners.
